ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: pictures on the floor
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: draw pictures the grown-ups want to keep
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: drew pictures the grown-ups wanted to keep

plain.li: I drew a horse on the floor with a burnt stick. Everyone said it was a dog. I'm going to get better.
I want to draw everyone in the colony, and have them look like themselves.
[sparked] I saw a grown-up make something beautiful, and now I want to make pictures too.
[tribal] I'm going to draw the animals on the stones, like the old ones did.

cheerful.li: I'm going to draw a picture so good they put it on the wall!

gloomy.li: My pictures come out wrong. I'm going to keep drawing until they don't.

blunt.li: Going to learn to draw. Properly.

warm.li: I want to draw a picture for everyone here, one each.

plain.li: I drew a picture of the colony and somebody asked if they could keep it. They kept it.
My drawings look like what they're of now. Mostly.

cheerful.li: Somebody put my picture up! On a wall! Where people can see it!

warm.li: I drew everybody, and everybody looked like themselves. They all said thank you.

cold.li: I can draw properly now. I'm going to draw harder things next.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the one to beat
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: win five friendly contests against the others

plain.li: [spark:Council_Moment_LostContest] I lost again today, and everyone saw. I'm going to {GOAL}, starting tomorrow.
Arm-wrestling, riddles, stories by the fire: whatever it is, I want to be the one to beat.
I'm going to {GOAL}. Fairly, mind. A win's no good otherwise.
[lowtech] Where I come from, the one who won the games at the feast sat at the head of the table. I'd like that seat.

warm.li: I like a good contest. I'd like to win a few, and buy the loser a drink each time.

cheerful.li: Nobody here can beat me at anything. Well, they can, but they won't for long.

gloomy.li: I lose at everything. Just once I'd like to win, and then four more times.

cold.li: Contests show who is really good at something. I intend to win enough of them to prove it.

plain.li: Five wins. People groan when I offer them a contest now, which is how I know.
That's the fifth contest I've won. I'm the one to beat here now.

warm.li: Five wins, and five drinks bought for the losers. Everyone's still talking to me.

blunt.li: Five. I'm the one to beat.

cheerful.li: Undefeated! Well, mostly defeated, but five wins all the same.

cold.li: Five contests won. The question of who is best has been answered for now.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: two masterworks
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make two pieces people stop to look at

plain.li: Most of what I make is good enough. I want to make something that's more than good enough. Twice, so I know it wasn't luck.
[sparked] I've seen what a real masterwork looks like. I'm going to {GOAL}.
One masterwork could be luck. Two would be skill. I'm going to {GOAL}.
[tribal] The best makers leave things behind that the children's children still use. I'd like to leave two.

warm.li: I'd like to make something so good that whoever uses it thinks of the colony every time.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make something so good the others fight over it. Then I'll make another.

gloomy.li: Everything I make has a flaw I can see. I want to make something without one.

cold.li: Excellent work, done twice, is the measure of a real maker. I will meet it.

plain.li: The second masterwork is finished. It wasn't luck.
Two pieces people stop to look at. I made both of them.

warm.li: Two of my pieces will be here long after I'm gone. That's a good feeling.

cheerful.li: Two! And the second one's even better than the first.

cold.li: Two masterworks made. My skill is proven.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the one who carries them out
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: carry three of our own out of a fight
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: carried three of the colony's people out of a fight

plain.li: [spark:downed] I lay there in the middle of the fight and someone came and carried me out. I want to be that someone for the others.
[spark:battle] In the last fight I saw one of ours go down and couldn't get to them. Next time I will.
[spark:RescuedMe] Someone carried me out when I couldn't walk. I owe that to the others now.
Nobody gets left lying in a fight while I'm standing. I'm going to {GOAL}.
[lowtech] My people honour the one who drags the fallen back behind the line. I'd like to earn that.

warm.li: When one of us goes down, I want to be the one who gets to them first.

blunt.li: Someone goes down, I get them out. Three times.

cheerful.li: I'm not the best shot, but I'm quick on my feet. I'll be the one who fetches people back.

gloomy.li: Someone's going to go down in the next fight. I want to make sure they don't stay down out there.

cold.li: A colonist left down in a fight is often a colonist lost. I will bring them back.

plain.li: That's the third one I've carried out of a fight. They're all still alive.
Three of ours carried out of the fighting. I'd do it a hundred more times.

warm.li: Three people are alive who might not have been. That's worth every risk.

cheerful.li: Three rescues! I should start charging for it.

cold.li: Three colonists carried out of danger. The habit is worth keeping.
